properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): add_capability was refused over a TemporalFact because TemporalFact↔Capability is not in PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS and every unlisted cross-type pair defaults to REFUSE — a finding blocks 4 of the 5 refusing constructors (all but add_decision); a recurrence of the 2026-09-16 class "a hand-maintained allowlist extended one measurement at a time", which #527 fixed by extending the list again
properties.statement:
① OBSERVED (dev_storyflow agent, 2026-09-24, art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27, verbatim): "creating a Capability was refused because a TemporalFact (a dated defect finding) read alike; the refusal itself said \"nothing here is a near-duplicate of a Capability\" and asked for `distinct_from`. Correct outcome, one wasted call — a dated finding and a capability are never duplicates of each other." Expected: the capability created, with the finding returned as a near-match note. NOT affected: a Decision written against the same finding (TemporalFact↔Decision is prescribed); same-type near-matches (refused by design).

② PRECEDENT: the CLASS is already recorded. fact:root-cause-the-guard-still-refuses-thread-pairs-because-the-prescribed-set-was-built-from-evidence-and-the-evidence-for-capability-component-arrived-today (2026-09-16) named it "a hand-maintained allowlist standing in for a rule the design already states, extended one measurement at a time"; its fix, chg:four-root-causes-from-two-field-reports-are-fixed-at-the-cause (#527), extended the list again by four pairs. THIS PAIR has no record: TemporalFact is in exactly one of the 14 prescribed pairs (↔Decision, #407, 2026-09-01), and `git log -S` shows no TemporalFact↔Capability entry ever. So this is a recurrence of a recorded class, and the fifth time the list has had to grow for a field report (08-31, 09-01, 09-05, 09-16, now). No duplicate cause minted; this fact records the new pair and the recurrence.

③ CANDIDATES (bones Precedent, Governance, Implementation, Contract, plus two off-graph): (a) TemporalFact↔Capability is missing from PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS, and any unlisted cross-type pair refuses by default (dec:idea-the-near-match-repair-can-now-be-reopened-because-the-count-exists chose "suppress the named pairings, keep every other cross-type check"); (b) the similarity floor (NEAR_MATCH_RATIO 0.5 of the new node's own score) is too low; (c) the guard's candidate pool includes observation records at all (search_first is deliberately not scoped by type); (d) not in the guard: the reporter ran an older build with a different list; (e) the observation is wrong: the refusal was really against a same-type or mixed set.

④ DISCRIMINATOR: the same finding and the same capability text, written through each refusing constructor. (a) predicts refused where the pair is unlisted and created-with-a-note where it is listed (Decision). (b) and (c) predict the SAME outcome for every constructor, because the score and the pool do not depend on the creating type. (d) predicts no reproduction on 0.72.0. (e) is ruled out by the wording alone: the "DIFFERENT KIND OF RECORD … Nothing here is a near-duplicate of a {type}" branch fires only when EVERY unacknowledged hit is of another type.

⑤ RESULT (published v0.72.0 binary, scratch stores only; capture.rs is byte-identical from v0.72.0 to HEAD 0beb693, so this measures the current source too). Seed: add_component cmp:sheet; record_finding fact:onboarding-spells-never-reach-the-sheet (defect, 24 words). Then the same 21-word text "the chosen spells that onboarding writes are read by the character sheet…" through each constructor:
    add_capability   -> REFUSED "Nothing here is a near-duplicate of a Capability", naming only the TemporalFact (the reporter's words, verbatim)
    add_requirement  -> REFUSED, same wording
    add_design_rule  -> REFUSED, same wording
    add_component    -> REFUSED, same wording
    add_decision     -> CREATED (proposed); the TemporalFact comes back in search_first.near_matches as a note
    add_constraint   -> CREATED with the note (report-only constructor)
    add_capability + distinct_from:[the fact] -> CREATED
The hit clears the floor for every type (it is in the Decision's note), and only list membership decides refuse vs note. (b) and (c) are refuted as the discriminator, (d) is refuted (it reproduces on 0.72.0 and the pair was never listed), and (a) survives. A second instance turned up in the same run: add_decision was REFUSED against a Constraint written minutes earlier, because Decision↔Constraint is unlisted too.

⑥ CLASS. The guard's type-scoping is implemented ONCE and SHARED: refuse_unless_deliberate + is_prescribed_layer + PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs ~154-229 and ~1089), called by the five refusing constructors (add_requirement, add_design_rule, add_capability, add_component, add_decision). add_constraint and add_interface only report. So this is not code copied per tool. The class sits in the POLICY at that one shared place: a cross-type pair refuses unless a field report has already been paid for it and someone added it. TemporalFact is paired with 1 of the 5 refusing types, so a finding blocks 4 of the 5. Every cross-type refusal counted so far has been a non-duplicate (19/0 across three designs on 2026-09-16, plus this one), and the refusal's own text concedes it. Would the #527 fix have prevented this report? No: it added four pairs, none involving TemporalFact. By step ⑥'s own test, that makes #527 an instance fix.

⑦ PIN (not written; code is out of scope for this triage). A class test would enumerate every (creating type, hit type) pair over the refusing constructors, seed a near-match of the hit type, and assert: same type -> refused; cross type -> created, with the hit present in search_first.near_matches. If the owner keeps a refusing subset, the test should assert that the subset follows from a STATED rule (for example "an observation — TemporalFact, ChangeEvent, Verification — never refuses an intent write") rather than from a list. On 0.72.0 it fails on TemporalFact->{Capability, Requirement, DesignRule, Component} and Constraint->Decision, among others.

⑧ FIX DIRECTION is the owner's call and is recorded as an idea, not a proposal: dec:idea-a-cross-type-near-match-is-a-note-and-only-a-same-type-one-refuses (the reporter's Opportunity).

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the reporter's exact texts and build on 2026-09-24 (the pair was never listed in any build, so the build does not change the verdict). The miss rate: whether any cross-type refusal has ever caught a real duplicate (the evidence says no; that is not proof). How many unlisted pairs occur in practice. Noticed and left alone: cap:search-first-at-the-tool's description lists Constraint as refusing and omits DesignRule, but on 0.72.0 add_constraint only reports and add_design_rule refuses.

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS. "A dated finding and a capability are never duplicates" is CONFIRMED: the refusal comes from the pair missing from a list, not from how strong the match was, and the tool's own wording says the hit is not a duplicate. The implied reading, that cross-type near-matches refuse, is only PARTLY right: the 14 listed cross-type pairs already do what the Opportunity asks (a note on success), and only unlisted pairs refuse.

STILL LIVE ON 0.74.0, seen 2026-09-28 in the dev_reflow2 hub session. add_capability for cap:an-exposed-server-establishes-who-is-calling-before-intent-can-be-settled was refused because a TemporalFact read alike: fact:root-cause-an-exposed-server-accepts-any-callers-signature-because-the-boundary-where-write-rules-attach-was-named-and-no-rule-was-chosen-2026-09-28, the root cause the capability exists to answer. The refusal itself said "Nothing here is a near-duplicate of a Capability". It was recovered in one retry with distinct_from. This is the expected pairing (a root cause, then the capability that answers it), which is the case this finding says should be a note and not a refusal.

RECURRENCE COUNTED, 2026-09-28 (late, dev_reflow2 hub session, reflow2 0.74.0): add_requirement was refused twice in one breath over fact:root-cause-a-sibling-designs-precedent-was-surfaced-three-times-and-never-read-2026-09-28, the finding the two requirements were written to answer ("Nothing here is a near-duplicate of a Requirement ... call again with distinct_from"). Both went through with distinct_from; add_capability needed the same twice more. Four wasted calls, the class unchanged.

RECURRENCE COUNTED, 2026-09-29 (dev_reflow2 hub session, islands promotion, reflow2 0.74.0). add_requirement was refused 3 times in one parallel batch. Each refusal named a TemporalFact the same session had written minutes earlier to hold the evidence those requirements cite:
- fact:measured-concurrency-across-all-designs-shows-no-lost-work-and-islands-would-mostly-block-a-sessions-own-subagents-2026-09-29, twice;
- fact:a-claim-cannot-tell-two-agents-of-one-person-apart-and-on-flo2-io-not-even-two-people-2026-09-29, once.
All three went through on retry with distinct_from. That is three more wasted calls, on the ordinary order this skill set asks for (write the finding first, then the intent it justifies). The class is unchanged.
